about.metaDescription: Why MessMate exists and how it keeps a shared mess fair.
about.title: Why MessMate
about.lead: A shared mess runs on trust — and on somebody's notebook.
about.p1: In most messes, one person keeps the hisab: who ate how much, who bought what, who has paid. It works until the notebook is lost, the month ends in an argument, or the person keeping it moves out.
about.p2: MessMate turns that notebook into a shared ledger. Every meal, expense and deposit is recorded once, timestamped, and visible to every member, so the month-end bill is a calculation, not a negotiation.

q1.title: One record for everyone
q1.body: Members see exactly what the manager sees. Changes to money leave an audit trail.

q2.title: Meals count as eaten
q2.body: Whole and half meals are recorded per member per day, and the meal rate is total groceries divided by total meals.

q3.title: Shared costs, split your way
q3.body: Gas, internet and the like can be split equally or by meals; rent is shared among members.

q4.title: Nothing hidden at the end
q4.body: Before closing, the manager previews every bill and any warnings, so there are no surprises.

faq.metaDescription: Answers about meal deadlines, half meals, bills and payments.
faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.lead: Still stuck? Write to us from the contact page.

q1.q: When do I have to plan tomorrow's meals?
q1.a: Before 11 PM Dhaka time the night before. After that the day locks and only the manager can change it.

q2.q: Can I eat half a meal?
q2.a: Yes. Meal counts go in steps of 0.5, from 0 to 10 per meal.

q3.q: How is my bill worked out?
q3.a: Your meals times the meal rate, plus your share of shared costs, plus your share of the rent — minus what you've deposited or paid on the mess's behalf. The meal rate is the month's groceries divided by the month's total meals.

q4.a: Online by card (Stripe) or bKash, or in cash to your manager, who records it. Cash can be partial; online payments cover the full amount due.

q5.q: Does the manager also eat and pay?
q5.a: Yes. A manager lives in the mess too, so they plan meals and pay a bill like everyone else.

q6.q: What happens if I leave the mess?
q6.a: Your manager removes you once you owe nothing. Your past meals and bills stay on the record.

q7.q: Can I use it in Bangla?
q7.a: Yes — switch between English and বাংলা from the top of any page.

q8.a: Members see the mess ledger, but only you see your own personal finance tracker and your payment history.
